title: Interpolation results quality
description: What the model says about itself with no reference calculation, and — added afterwards by q3.workflows.wannier, which runs the calculation they need — the band distance against a direct one and the verdict it earned.

localization_converged.description: Repeated from spread.localization_converged when the gauge was minimised, so the block a driver judges by is complete on its own.

status.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: "accept" or "reject", the verdict of the retry ladder on this model.

reason.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: why the verdict was reached, in words.

ladder.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: every evaluation the retry ladder made of the saved record, in order, ending with the one this file describes.
